claims.title: Polynomial-bit matrix signing at joint-support and effective-rank scales, with exact variance reductions

quoted_fields.interface: Every N,d>=1 and explicit rational Hermitian d-by-d matrices H_i, real and imaginary parts in binary, complete input length B. Set r=max rank(H_i), Q=sum_i H_i^2 and sigma=||Q||^(1/2). Assign ONE sign to each ORIGINAL H_i, shared by all its eigenvectors/blocks. The full target is a uniform deterministic algorithm with absolute computable C,c, bound C*sigma*sqrt(log(2r)) for nonzero input, and <=C*(N+d+B)^c BIT operations. All-zero inputs return arbitrary signs. No positivity, isotropy, conditioning, spectral gap or lower bound on nonzero sigma is promised. Charge rank/preprocessing, normalization, precision, root/eigenvalue work, all iterations and output; no exact-real, spectral, SDP-value or conditional-expectation oracle or supplied good signs.

The rank-two trace-scale separation diagnoses that imported guarantee, not a variance-signing impossibility.
